help.title: Help & FAQ
help.subtitle: Quick answers about booking, paying and finding opponents.
help.contact: Still stuck? Open Messages and write to PitchKH Support. We answer in English and Khmer, 7am to 10pm.

q1.q: How do I book a field?
q1.a: Open a venue, tap Book now, then pick the field, the day and your start and end time. Add a referee or extras if you want them, pay, and you get a receipt with a booking code.

q2.q: How long can I book for?
q2.a: Between 1 and 4 hours, in 30-minute steps. You can book up to 30 days ahead.

q3.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
q3.a: Yes. Cancel or reschedule for free up to 2 hours before the start time from My bookings. Online payments are refunded to the wallet you paid with.

q4.q: Why is a slot greyed out?
q4.a: Someone already booked it, the venue blocked it for maintenance, or the time has passed. Greyed-out slots can't be selected.

q1.q: Which payment methods can I use?
q1.a: KHQR (any Bakong-enabled bank app), ABA Pay, Wing, or cash when you arrive.

q2.q: Why are prices in dollars and riel?
q2.a: Venues set prices in US dollars. We show the riel amount at 4,100 ៛ per dollar so you know what to expect at the counter.

q3.q: What happens when I choose cash?
q3.a: Your booking is sent to the venue as a request. The slot is held for you, and the booking is confirmed once the owner accepts it.

q1.a: Football and volleyball. Tennis courts are booked directly.

q2.a: Post a match with the venue, time and level. Other teams ask to join, you accept one, and a chat opens between both captains.

q3.a: After a match each captain can rate the other team from 1 to 5. The average shows on the team's profile.

q1.q: How do I list my venue?
q1.a: Create a venue owner account, add your venue and fields, then submit. Our team reviews new listings before they appear in search.

q2.q: How do I block time for maintenance?
q2.a: Open Schedule in your dashboard, pick the field and day, and add a blocked time. Players won't be able to book it.

legal.demoNotice: PitchKH is running in demo mode. Payments are simulated and no real booking is made with any venue.

s1.title: Using PitchKH
s1.body: PitchKH lets players book sports fields listed by independent venue owners and arrange matches with other teams. You need an account to book, and you are responsible for activity on it.

s2.title: Bookings and payment
s2.body: A booking is an agreement between you and the venue. The price shown at checkout is final and includes the platform service fee. Cash bookings are confirmed only after the venue accepts them.

s3.title: Cancellations
s3.body: You may cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 2 hours before the start time. After that the venue may keep the full amount.

s4.title: Fair play
s4.body: Arrive on time, respect the venue's rules and your opponents. Accounts that repeatedly fail to show up or behave abusively may be suspended.

s5.title: Venue listings
s5.body: Owners must describe their fields accurately and honour confirmed bookings. PitchKH may remove listings that mislead players or are unsafe.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.body: Your name, phone number, email and language, plus the bookings, matches, messages and reviews you create.

s2.title: How we use it
s2.body: To make and manage your bookings, show your team to possible opponents, send notifications about your games, and keep the platform safe.

s3.title: Who can see it
s3.body: A venue sees your name and phone number for bookings you make there. Other teams see your team profile, not your contact details.

s4.title: Storage in this demo
s4.body: In demo mode all data stays in your own browser and is never sent to a server. Clearing your browser data removes it.

s5.title: Your choices
s5.body: You can edit your profile at any time and ask support to delete your account and its data.
